name: Psychic Satanic
overview: Scripture clearly warns believers against seeking guidance from familiar spirits, wizards, or those who claim psychic insight, as such practices defile and lead away from God’s truth (Leviticus 19:31; Isaiah 8:19). Instead, believers are called to reject and expose the works of darkness rather than participate in them (Ephesians 5:11). The wisdom behind these occult practices is described as earthly, sensual, and devilish, contrasting sharply with the divine wisdom that comes from above (James 3:15).
